prompt: Name a song from Michael Jackson's Thriller.
note: The standard nine-track Thriller (1982) running order — no regional variant issue here, unlike some early-80s albums. Genuinely closed: all nine are scoring answers, nothing trimmed into extras, so every excluded Jackson song below is wrong on the merits (a different album), never just past a cutoff on this one.

answers.name: Thriller
answers.fact: The title track and closing song, built around Vincent Price's spoken outro — paid session work he almost turned down.

answers.name: Billie Jean
answers.fact: The bassline was recorded first and kept as the foundation of the whole track, unusually for Jackson's process.

answers.name: Beat It
answers.fact: Eddie Van Halen played the guitar solo for free, as a favor, without telling his own band first.

answers.name: Human Nature
answers.fact: Co-written by Toto's Steve Porcaro, originally for his own daughter, before Quincy Jones asked to use it.

answers.name: P.Y.T. (Pretty Young Thing)
answers.fact: Jackson's sisters Janet and La Toya sang the uncredited backing vocals.

answers.name: Wanna Be Startin' Somethin'
answers.fact: Its closing chant samples a Cameroonian song, 'Soul Makossa,' uncredited until a later lawsuit settled it.

answers.name: The Girl Is Mine
answers.fact: A duet with Paul McCartney — the second time the two had recorded together, after McCartney's own 'Say Say Say.'

answers.name: Baby Be Mine
answers.fact: Never released as a single, one of only two Thriller tracks that wasn't.

answers.name: The Lady in My Life
answers.fact: The album's closing ballad; Jackson reportedly re-recorded his vocal after producer Quincy Jones asked for more 'pleading.'

distractors.name: Bad
distractors.note: The title track from the next album, not this one.

distractors.name: Black or White
distractors.note: That's from Dangerous (1991), two albums later.

distractors.name: Rock With You
distractors.note: That's from Off the Wall (1979), the album before Thriller.

distractors.name: Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough
distractors.note: Also from Off the Wall (1979), not Thriller.
